answer: Funder-ladder fees price each new key by its siblings. The atlas is a public registry mapping every key to the wallet that first funded it. A funder's n-th key pays n squared POA to register, burned, and the zenith is a cap of 50 keys per funder; the ladder resets only after 30 idle days, tracked by an ember counter. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 20 funders at 1+4+...+2500 = 42,925 POA each. Attacker pays 858,500 POA this epoch.
